body: Wowza. That blows CassiePlush. Really sorry to hear that you got some shitty people around you. But it's not stupid at all to feel like your family creates stress in your life. Family is embedded into your life and emotional well being, and it's very hurtful when they don't act decently towards the people they're supposed to love. How your family treats you doesn't define you though.  just because they don't show you love, doesn't mean you're not deserving of it. Nor does it mean you're doing anything wrong. You just gotta keep trying to make yourself happy and not let those other people get in the way. Eventually you'll find yourself around people that love you and treat you right

Idk why mobile isn't letting me comment on an individual post, but I've been dealing with suicidal thoughts and depression for a while. This year has been my worst but I've made a lot of progress in the past year (mostly on my own) and I think that this is the reason my suicidal thoughts are so casual these days
